meta.scope: E-commerce audit: UX/UI, latency, bugs, resilience/DDoS posture, system failures, load, unit and E2E testing, data metrics, compliance
meta.editor_target: VS Code GitHub Copilot agent mode (works in Cursor)
meta.constraint: Behaviour-preserving: strengthen and improve only; no feature or functionality change

scope_and_limits: Static retrieval of public pages only; no browser, no JavaScript execution.
No attack, load or vulnerability traffic was sent to the live site; all such items are supplied as plans for staging.
Security, resilience, testing and data items are marked Untested where evidence needs authorized access or the repository.
robots.txt, sitemap.xml, login and response headers could not be retrieved in this session.
corrections_to_earlier_reports: Earlier reports said the Deals section had no urgency mechanism. It has a countdown (now VM-012, a verification item). Withdrawn: L-06.
Earlier reports said support was email-only with a 1-2 day reply. The site now offers WhatsApp and a phone line; email replies are stated as Mon-Sat. L-04 is replaced by VM-011.
Earlier reports said a skip link was likely missing. It is present. Withdrawn.
Earlier reports asked whether filters exist. They do (category pages). Search autosuggest remains unverified.
Earlier reports treated business identity disclosure as unconfirmed. Address and a generic grievance contact are visible; entity name and GSTIN are not (VM-043).
Earlier slug finding is confirmed and worse than first described (model names repeat, duplicate listing with a '-2' suffix).
The site changes over time; earlier fetches may reflect an older build. This pack is based on 4 November 2026 fetches.

evidence_log.note: Headings and links; no body text in extraction
Header and footer; no form content in extraction
Disallowed to automated clients by the site
Sandbox proxy returned 403 on a header request

strengths_observed: Clear information architecture with eight top categories, brands, deals, guides, programs, rentals, used and gear exchange.
Skip-to-main-content link present on every fetched page.
Canonical tags on home, cart, category and product pages; en_IN locale; viewport-fit set.
Product pages expose price, MRP, GST rate, SKU, stock state, warranty and seller; prices stated inclusive of taxes.
Open Graph product tags carry price, currency, availability, brand and condition.
Pre-sized image variants on the CDN (-w320, -w480, -w1600).
Category pages offer filters (brand, price, condition, rating, availability), sorting and pagination.
Delivery estimate and pincode update on product pages; WhatsApp, phone and email support routes.
Policy set (terms, privacy, cookies, shipping, returns) linked in the footer, with address and grievance contact.

findings.title: Free-shipping promise contradicts itself across pages
findings.evidence: Banner reads 'Free Shipping on Orders Above Rs 5,000*' on home, product, shipping and contact pages; 'Free shipping on every order' on category, cart, returns and privacy pages, the homepage trust tiles and the product page ('Free delivery on every order').
findings.impact: Misleading-advertising exposure, order disputes and checkout surprise.
findings.fix: Create one SHIPPING_POLICY constant (threshold, wording) and render every banner, trust tile and PDP badge from it. Owner states the true rule; shipping calculation logic is not touched.
findings.acceptance: Zero hard-coded shipping strings in the repo; 8 sampled pages show identical wording; shipping page states the same rule.

findings.title: Support phone and social links differ between pages
findings.evidence: Cart page footer shows +91 97736 51006 and facebook/instagram/x/linkedin '.../vibemusic'; other pages show +91 891 048 2950 and '.../vibemusicindiaofficial' and '.../vibemusicindia'. LinkedIn icon on returns and privacy pages points to x.com. Instagram URL carries an 'stkn' tracking token.
findings.impact: Customers may call a wrong number; broken brand trust; minor privacy leak.
findings.fix: Single SITE_CONTACT config consumed by every footer; fix LinkedIn href; strip the stkn parameter. Owner confirms the authoritative phone and handles.
findings.acceptance: One phone number and one set of social URLs across all pages; link checker returns 0 mismatches.

findings.title: Two header and footer variants are in use
findings.evidence: Home, product, shipping and contact pages render a bar with 'Track Order -> /account/orders', 'Help & Support -> /support', '/shipping-policy', '/why-shop-with-us'; category, cart, returns and privacy pages render a different bar and a footer with a Social column. Footer routes use /pages/shipping and /contact.
findings.impact: Inconsistent navigation and possible orphan or 404 routes.
findings.fix: Unify into one layout component; confirm each target returns 200 or one 301 to the canonical route.
findings.acceptance: One header component; crawl shows 0 broken internal links.

findings.title: Category and search URL variants are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Nav variants link /category/keyboards-pianos and /category/accessories versus /category/keyboards-synthesizers and /category/cables-cases-accessories; /category/Amplifier-Effects is mixed case; two search patterns /search?q= and /search/results?q=.
findings.impact: Duplicate content, possible 404s, diluted ranking.
findings.fix: Canonical slug map; lowercase enforcement; 301 legacy and case variants to the canonical route (redirects only).
findings.acceptance: Every variant resolves 200 or a single 301 hop; canonical tag present.

findings.title: Brand claims in category tiles may exceed the catalogue
findings.evidence: Tiles name Universal Audio, Focusrite, Neumann, Moog, Nord, Pearl, Shure, Sennheiser, AKG, Pioneer DJ, Denon, Rane, QSC, Yamaha, Chauvet, Hosa, Gator, On-Stage; the Top Brands row lists Roland, HERTZ, ZOOM, GIBRALTAR, ADEON, ZILDJIAN, HARTKE, M-AUDIO; the Guitars facet shows HERTZ (32) only.
findings.impact: If unstocked or unauthorized, conflicts with '100% Genuine / Authorized brands' claims.
findings.fix: Owner confirms each brand; bind tile brand lists to live catalogue data or remove unconfirmed names.
findings.acceptance: Every brand named has at least one live SKU or an authorization record on file.

findings.title: Same model listed with conflicting price, MRP and SKU
findings.evidence: HZA-3900 product page: Rs 7,100, MRP Rs 8,068 (12% off); category cards for HZA-3900 (bk) and HZA-3900 EQ (TS): Rs 6,818, MRP Rs 10,490 (35% off); /hertz-hza3900eq-hza3900eq also Rs 7,100. Product page header SKU VM-HZA3900EQ versus details SKU VM-HZA3900.
findings.impact: Price integrity, discount substantiation and inventory-mapping risk (wrong item shipped or oversold).
findings.fix: Read-only data audit script grouping listings by model code and reporting conflicting MRP, price and SKU; add a validation rule blocking two active listings with the same SKU. Owner reconciles MRP.
findings.acceptance: Audit report shows 0 conflicting MRPs and 0 duplicate SKUs per model family.

findings.title: Duplicated slugs and an exact duplicate listing
findings.evidence: Slugs repeat brand or model: hertz-hertz-hza-uk-24-hertz-hza-uk-24, adeon-adeon-aedan-pro1-adeon-aedan-pro1, avus-avus-hathor-16-avus-hathor-16, hertz-hza-3900-hza-3900; two 'Mint Green' STMP-X listings (one ending '-2'); several slugs exceed 200 characters.
findings.impact: SEO cannibalisation and unreadable URLs.
findings.fix: Fix the slug generator (token dedupe, 80-character cap); keep every old URL alive with a 301 to the new canonical.
findings.acceptance: No slug repeats a token sequence; all legacy URLs 301 correctly.

findings.title: Catalogue taxonomy is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Guitars facets: 'Acoustic Guitar (7)', 'Acoustic Guitars (3)', 'Guitar (1)', 'Electro Acoustic Guitar (4)', 'Acoustic-Electric Guitars (1)'.
findings.impact: Fragmented filters and weaker discovery.
findings.fix: Normalise subcategory values through a mapping script; filter behaviour is unchanged.
findings.acceptance: One label per concept in every category facet.

findings.title: Instagram section uses placeholder images
findings.evidence: Ten tiles reuse a handful of static images (guitar-1/2, drum-1/2) while linking to different reels, mostly from @hertzmusicindia.
findings.impact: Looks like a live feed but is not; trust and relevance loss.
findings.fix: Use true thumbnails or relabel as 'Follow us'; no functional change.
findings.acceptance: Each tile image matches its linked reel or the section is relabelled.

findings.title: Third-party image host used on the homepage
findings.evidence: Banner images load from myimgs.org alongside cdn.vibemusic.in and vibemusic.in/images.
findings.impact: Availability, privacy and CSP surface outside your control.
findings.fix: Mirror assets to cdn.vibemusic.in; allow-list only owned hosts.
findings.acceptance: Zero requests to third-party image hosts on the five key pages.

findings.title: Dispatch and support wording contradicts itself
findings.evidence: 'Same-day' versus 'dispatches within 1-2 business days'; 'FREE delivery Wednesday, 11 November' shown on 4 November; 'advisors reply by email' while WhatsApp and phone exist.
findings.impact: Expectation gaps and support load.
findings.fix: Align copy to the operations SLA; derive delivery estimate from the same SLA constant.
findings.acceptance: One SLA statement used everywhere.

findings.title: Countdown timers need proof they are real
findings.evidence: Deals countdown shows placeholders in server HTML; product page shows 'Order within 11 hrs 12 mins'.
findings.impact: False urgency is a recognised dark pattern under India's consumer guidelines.
findings.fix: Document the data source of each timer; relabel any evergreen timer.
findings.acceptance: Each timer maps to a real cutoff in code or is relabelled.

findings.title: Cart badge renders as '0Cart'
findings.evidence: Cart page markup shows count and label fused.
findings.impact: Screen readers announce one garbled word (WCAG 4.1.2).
findings.fix: Separate spans with a visually hidden label and an aria-live count; no visual change.
findings.acceptance: Screen reader reads 'Cart, N items'; axe reports 0 issues on the header.

findings.title: Rails and marquee content duplicated in the DOM
findings.evidence: Homepage trending rail lists 8 products twice; brand logos, store cards, Instagram tiles and marquee text each appear twice; Staff Picks repeats the same eight products as Explore Trending.
findings.impact: Heavier DOM, repeated screen-reader output, weaker merchandising.
findings.fix: Create loop clones on the client with aria-hidden and inert; give Staff Picks its own source list.
findings.acceptance: Server HTML contains each product anchor once per rail; homepage DOM nodes reduced at least 25%.

findings.title: '?' characters appear where separators belong
findings.evidence: Category tiles read 'Studio Interfaces ? Monitors ? Mics' and 'Universal Audio ? Focusrite ? Neumann'.
findings.impact: Looks like an encoding fault; may be an extraction artifact.
findings.fix: Check in a browser; use CSS or UTF-8 separators.
findings.acceptance: No '?' separators on any tile.

findings.title: Product spec template groups data under wrong headings
findings.evidence: Colour sits under 'Dimensions & weight'; Model, Instrument and Variant sit under 'Keyboard & performance' on a guitar page; the same fields repeat in three tables; colour shown as raw codes 'TS/NA/BK'.
findings.impact: Reads as unfinished; weakens trust on high-ticket items.
findings.fix: Category-aware spec groups, hide irrelevant headings, expand codes via a map.
findings.acceptance: No cross-category headings on any PDP sample.

findings.title: Deferred modules show 'Loading...' in server HTML
findings.evidence: Product page: 'Loading offers', 'Loading reviews', 'Loading Q&A'.
findings.impact: Layout shift and blank states.
findings.fix: Reserve space with min-height and add empty-state copy.
findings.acceptance: CLS under 0.1 on product pages.

findings.title: Very long product titles and truncated meta description
findings.evidence: Product H1 and title run roughly 170 characters; meta description is cut mid-word ('...stylish finish opti').
findings.impact: Poor scan-ability and weak search snippets.
findings.fix: Separate display title (70 characters or fewer) from SEO title; trim descriptions at a word boundary (155 or fewer).
findings.acceptance: H1 at most 90 characters; no mid-word truncation.

findings.title: Accessibility checks beyond markup not yet run
findings.evidence: Skip-to-main link is present (strength). Focus visibility, contrast, keyboard-only checkout and 200% zoom are not verified.
findings.impact: WCAG 2.1 AA conformance unknown.
findings.fix: Run axe and a manual keyboard and screen-reader pass; fix without redesign.
findings.acceptance: Zero critical or serious axe issues on the five key pages.

findings.title: Utility pages inherit homepage metadata
findings.evidence: Cart, returns, privacy, shipping and contact carry og:url https://vibemusic.in and the homepage og:title; canonical absent on returns, shipping, privacy and contact (present on home, cart, product, category).
findings.impact: Wrong social previews and weaker canonical signals.
findings.fix: Per-route metadata with self-referencing canonical on every indexable page.
findings.acceptance: Each route has unique title, og:url and canonical.

findings.title: Indexation controls for transactional pages not visible
findings.evidence: No robots meta observed for cart, login, account or track-order. robots.txt and sitemap.xml could not be retrieved by the audit tool.
findings.impact: Thin utility pages may be indexed.
findings.fix: noindex,follow on cart, checkout, account, login, track-order; review robots.txt and sitemap.
findings.acceptance: robots.txt and sitemap fetched, valid and submitted in Search Console.

findings.title: Structured data not observed
findings.evidence: Open Graph product tags exist (price, availability, brand, condition); JSON-LD not visible in extracted markup.
findings.impact: No rich results (price, availability) if absent.
findings.fix: Emit Product, Offer, BreadcrumbList and Organization JSON-LD from existing data (no UI change).
findings.acceptance: Rich Results Test passes on three sample products.

findings.title: Product share image served as PNG
findings.evidence: Product og:image points to a .png on the CDN.
findings.impact: Heavy share previews.
findings.fix: Serve 1200x630 JPG or WebP at 200 KB or less.
findings.acceptance: og:image at most 200 KB.

findings.title: Filter URLs may create duplicate content
findings.evidence: Parameter URLs such as /search/results?category=guitars&subcategory=Acoustic.
findings.impact: Crawl budget waste and duplicate pages.
findings.fix: Canonical to the base category and noindex faceted combinations; keep pagination crawlable.
findings.acceptance: Facet URLs canonicalised; no duplicate titles in a crawl.

findings.title: Homepage carries a very large server payload
findings.evidence: More than 14 sections and well over 80 product anchors in server HTML, much of it duplicated.
findings.impact: Slower LCP on mobile networks.
findings.fix: Lazy-render below-fold rails, drop duplicates (see VM-014), defer non-critical images.
findings.acceptance: Mobile LCP at most 2.5 s (p75); HTML at least 30% smaller.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals baseline not captured
findings.evidence: No field or lab data collected in this audit.
findings.impact: No way to prove improvement.
findings.fix: Capture PageSpeed, WebPageTest (Mumbai and Delhi) and CrUX for home, category, product, cart, checkout.
findings.acceptance: Baseline stored in the metrics ledger before any change.

findings.title: Image pipeline is mixed
findings.evidence: Strength: pre-sized variants (-w320, -w480, -w1600) on the CDN. Gaps: homepage editorial via /_next/image w=1920, PNG brand logos, JPG store photos.
findings.impact: Avoidable bytes.
findings.fix: Correct sizes attributes, AVIF or WebP, lazy-load below fold, priority hint on the LCP image.
findings.acceptance: Image bytes on homepage down at least 30%.

findings.title: Third-party script origins not enumerated
findings.evidence: Payment, analytics, embeds and chat origins not captured.
findings.impact: Unknown main-thread cost and CSP scope.
findings.fix: Build a request map and remove or defer non-critical scripts.
findings.acceptance: Each third-party origin has an owner and a cost.

findings.title: Checkout total must be recalculated on the server
findings.evidence: Homepage publicly states 'Razorpay-encrypted checkout with server-verified totals'. Not tested.
findings.impact: If untrue: price tampering and a false public claim.
findings.fix: Server recomputes every line from the database and ignores client prices; add a tampering test.
findings.acceptance: Tampered-price request rejected or corrected; test in CI.

findings.title: Object-level authorization on orders, wishlist, addresses and track-order
findings.evidence: Guest 'Track your order' route exists. Not tested.
findings.impact: One customer could read another's order data.
findings.fix: Check ownership on every user-scoped read; bind guest tracking to order ID plus verified email or phone.
findings.acceptance: Cross-account access returns 403 or 404 in staging tests.

findings.title: Security response headers unverified
findings.evidence: The audit sandbox could not read response headers (proxy returned 403).
findings.impact: Missing CSP, HSTS and frame protection raise the blast radius of any bug.
findings.fix: Read headers with curl -I from your machine; add missing headers in next.config.js with a report-only CSP first.
findings.acceptance: securityheaders.com A grade; no CSP violations on core flows.

findings.title: Authentication hardening
findings.evidence: Login is disallowed to automated clients by the site's robots rules, so it was not probed.
findings.impact: Credential stuffing and account enumeration risk.
findings.fix: Rate-limit login, register and reset; uniform error messages; secure cookie flags.
findings.acceptance: Eleventh failed login in a minute returns 429; identical error for unknown and known emails.

findings.title: Payment webhook signature and idempotency
findings.evidence: Razorpay integration not inspected.
findings.impact: Spoofed 'paid' callbacks or double orders.
findings.fix: Verify gateway signature on every webhook; idempotency key on order creation.
findings.acceptance: Forged webhook rejected; replay creates no second order.

findings.title: Dependency and secret hygiene
findings.evidence: Repository not available to this audit.
findings.impact: Known CVEs or leaked keys.
findings.fix: Run npm audit and a secret scan including git history; rotate anything found.
findings.acceptance: No critical or high findings; secrets only in the host secret manager.

findings.title: Consent banner and tracking scripts
findings.evidence: No cookie-consent banner text observed on any fetched page; a cookie policy page exists. Newsletter checkbox default state unknown.
findings.impact: Tracking before consent; DPDP exposure.
findings.fix: Verify in a browser network panel; gate non-essential scripts until consent; checkbox must not be pre-ticked.
findings.acceptance: No analytics request before consent.

findings.title: Edge protection and origin exposure
findings.evidence: CDN or WAF presence not visible (headers unreadable here).
findings.impact: Direct origin exposure to volumetric traffic.
findings.fix: Confirm edge layer, lock origin to edge IP ranges, enable bot and rate rules.
findings.acceptance: Origin refuses non-edge traffic.

findings.title: Rate limits on search, cart, checkout, contact and newsletter
findings.evidence: Newsletter form on every page; 'Buy Now' on every product card.
findings.impact: Cheap abuse vectors.
findings.fix: Per-IP and per-session limits with 429 and Retry-After.
findings.acceptance: Scripted burst beyond the limit is throttled in staging.

findings.title: Inventory decrement under concurrency
findings.evidence: Stock states 'In stock' and 'Limited' exist; behaviour under parallel orders unknown.
findings.impact: Overselling the last unit.
findings.fix: Atomic conditional update (decrement where stock > 0) plus unique order idempotency.
findings.acceptance: 1,000 parallel orders on a stock-of-5 SKU create exactly 5 orders.

findings.title: Graceful degradation of non-critical modules
findings.evidence: Offers, reviews, Q&A, Instagram and third-party images load separately.
findings.impact: One failing dependency could break a page.
findings.fix: Error boundaries and timeouts; checkout never depends on a non-critical module.
findings.acceptance: Fault-injection test leaves purchase flow working.

findings.title: Monitoring, alerting, backups and rollback undocumented
findings.evidence: No evidence available.
findings.impact: Slow detection and recovery.
findings.fix: Uptime, error tracking, payment-failure alerts, a scheduled synthetic checkout, documented RPO and RTO, tested rollback.
findings.acceptance: Alert fires in a drill within 5 minutes.

findings.title: No visible automated test safety net
findings.evidence: Repository not available.
findings.impact: Any change can silently break checkout.
findings.fix: Add characterization (golden) tests first, then unit, integration and E2E in CI as a merge gate.
findings.acceptance: CI blocks merges on failing checkout tests.

findings.title: Policy page bodies absent in extracted pages
findings.evidence: Returns, shipping and privacy pages returned headings and links but no body text (returns meta description mentions a 7-day window).
findings.impact: Consumer-rule disclosures and a data-protection notice must be visible.
findings.fix: Confirm in a browser; if the body is client-rendered make it server-rendered.
findings.acceptance: Full policy text present in server HTML.

findings.title: Legal entity and tax identifiers not visible; grievance officer unnamed
findings.evidence: Footer shows trade name, Kolkata address and 'Customer Grievance Officer (support@vibemusic.in)'; no legal entity name, GSTIN or named officer.
findings.impact: Gap against e-commerce disclosure expectations.
findings.fix: Owner supplies entity name, GSTIN and officer name; render from SITE_CONTACT config.
findings.acceptance: Details visible in footer and policy pages.

findings.title: DPDP Act readiness
findings.evidence: DPDP Rules were notified in November 2025 with a phased rollout of about 18 months.
findings.impact: Notice, consent, retention and breach duties apply on a timetable.
findings.fix: Counsel maps duties to data flows; engineering implements the notice and consent wording.
findings.acceptance: Written compliance map signed off by counsel.

findings.title: Dark-pattern self-audit
findings.evidence: 'Price Protection - Worry-free shopping' has no visible terms; timers (VM-012); newsletter consent default unknown.
findings.impact: Vague claims and nudges are enforcement targets.
findings.fix: Add terms to each vague claim or remove it; confirm no pre-ticked consent.
findings.acceptance: Checklist signed off by owner.

findings.title: Analytics and funnel instrumentation unverified
findings.evidence: No evidence of e-commerce event tracking.
findings.impact: No baseline, no proof of improvement.
findings.fix: Verify GA4 events (view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase) and server-side backup; log zero-result searches.
findings.acceptance: Funnel dashboard shows every step with less than 5% event loss.

feature_backlog_out_of_scope.item: Search autosuggest with image and price preview
feature_backlog_out_of_scope.why: Not verifiable from static markup; adding it is a new feature, so it is outside the no-feature-change rule.

feature_backlog_out_of_scope.item: Variant model (one product, many finishes) instead of separate listings
feature_backlog_out_of_scope.why: Changes catalogue behaviour; plan as a separate project.

feature_backlog_out_of_scope.item: Live chat widget with visible response time
feature_backlog_out_of_scope.why: WhatsApp and phone already exist; new capability.

feature_backlog_out_of_scope.item: Real review collection and photo reviews
feature_backlog_out_of_scope.why: New capability; product pages currently show 'Be the first to review'.

unit: Price and money: integer-paise arithmetic, rounding, GST inclusive/exclusive, MRP versus selling price, discount percentage (boundaries 0%, 100%, negative rejected).
Shipping rule: threshold equals Rs 5,000 boundary (4,999 / 5,000 / 5,001) once the owner fixes the rule.
Slug generator: no repeated brand or model tokens, length cap, unicode, collision suffix, idempotence.
Cart reducer: add, update, remove, quantity bounds, stock cap, merge guest cart on login.
Coupon engine: valid, expired, minimum value, stacking, tampered discount value ignored.
Delivery estimate: cutoff time, weekends and holidays, pincode serviceability.
Inventory decrement: conditional update returns affected rows; zero rows means rejection.
Validators: phone, PIN code, email, address length; error messages.
Metadata builders: unique title, canonical, og:url per route; description trimmed at word boundary.
SITE_CONTACT and SHIPPING_POLICY constants: every consumer reads from them (grep test).
integration: Create-order endpoint recomputes totals from the database and ignores client prices.
Payment webhook: valid signature accepted once; forged or replayed rejected.
Auth: rate limit, uniform errors, session cookie flags, logout invalidation.
Order, wishlist, address and track-order endpoints enforce ownership.
Search and filter API: pagination without duplicates; zero-result response.
Email and SMS triggers on order, shipment and password reset.
Redirect map: legacy slugs and case variants return one 301 to the canonical URL.
e2e: Guest checkout end to end in the payment sandbox, mobile and desktop.
Registered user checkout with saved address; reorder from history.
Search, filter, sort, add to cart; out-of-stock behaviour.
Coupon apply and remove; shipping threshold crossing.
Track order with valid and invalid IDs; cross-account attempt blocked.
Return or exchange initiation within and outside the 7-day window.
Keyboard-only checkout and screen-reader smoke test.
Cross-browser run: Chromium, WebKit, Firefox, Pixel and iPhone profiles.
load_staging_only: Baseline: ramp to 500 virtual users, hold 5 minutes; p95 under 1 s, errors under 1%.
Search and category: 200 concurrent users with varied queries; no pool exhaustion.
Cart add and update: 300 concurrent; totals stay correct.
Flash sale: 1,000 concurrent orders on a stock-of-5 SKU; exactly 5 orders.
Soak: 150 users for 60 minutes; flat memory and latency.
Spike: 10 to 2,000 users in 10 seconds; no 5xx storm.
resilience_defensive: Confirm edge layer and that the origin rejects non-edge traffic.
Confirm per-IP rate limits return 429 on search, cart, checkout, contact, newsletter and login.
Fault injection in staging: block Instagram, third-party images, offers and reviews APIs; checkout must still work.
Payment gateway timeout and decline paths; no duplicate orders.
Budget alerts and maximum autoscaling caps to prevent cost-based denial.
Backup restore drill and rollback drill with recorded RTO.
accessibility: axe scan and manual keyboard pass on the five key pages; focus visible; contrast 4.5:1; 200% zoom; reduced motion for marquees.
seo: Crawl for duplicate titles, canonicals, redirects, orphan routes; Rich Results Test on three products; robots and sitemap validity.
data: GA4 event audit, consent gating, zero-result search log, funnel drop-off by step, weekly dashboard.

kpi_targets_and_ledger.metric: Checkout E2E pass rate in CI

release_gates.name: Trust boundaries proven
release_gates.evidence: Tests pass in staging and CI

scorecard.note: Contradictory shipping claim, mixed contact details, duplicate or conflicting listings
Strong IA, filters, skip link; duplication and spec-template gaps
Skip link present; badge markup and deeper checks outstanding
Canonicals on core pages; utility pages inherit wrong metadata; schema unverified
Address and grievance contact present; policy bodies, entity, GSTIN not visible

verdict.status: CONDITIONAL - not yet certifiable as 10/10 production ready
verdict.evidence_based_average: 5.8 / 10 across the five domains that could be observed; the other five domains receive no credit until tested
verdict.summary: The storefront is presentable and structurally sound, but confirmed content and pricing inconsistencies plus untested trust boundaries (checkout totals, object authorization, edge protection, test coverage) prevent a 10/10 verdict today. A 10/10 can be awarded only when gates G1 to G9 pass with recorded evidence.
